Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was specifically performed on the hiPSC-CM model. While the study also includes a mouse TAC model, the mass spectrometry section and the associated results (Fig 6) explicitly refer to the ET1-treated hiPSC-CMs and the preventive effects of Sac and Val.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: Data was acquired in data dependent acquisition (DDA) mode and quantified using the Minora Algorithm (label-free quantification) in Proteome Discoverer.

differential: Volcano plots depict 240 (197 higher, 43 lower) dysregulated proteins in ET1-treated samples vs. control

search_parameters: Carbamidomethylation was set as a fixed modification for cysteine residues

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment focuses on the proteomic changes in hiPSC-CMs treated with ET1 and various combinations of Sacubitril and Valsartan. While the study discusses the ubiquitin-proteasome system (UPS), the MS analysis was a global proteome search rather than a specialized ubiquitome enrichment (no diGly or remnant-specific search parameters were specified for the MS data processing).
